sloka: लक्ष्मणेन सहायेन प्रयातः केकयेश्वरः ।हते ऽसुरे यथा वृत्रे विष्णुना सह वासवः ।। ७.३८.१५ ॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena sahāyena prayātaḥ kekayeśvaraḥ ।hate 'sure yathā vṛtre viṣṇunā saha vāsavaḥ ।। 7.38.15 ॥

translations.english: The lord of Kekaya departed with Lakshmana's help, just as Indra, with Vishnu, went after the demon Vritra was killed.
